capabilities: Set a font for an individual note from a right-click menu
Set a per-note font size between 8 and 96 px
Reset a note to the vault's default typography
Store font choices per note path without editing note content
extras: Distributed as a manual zip download rather than through the community plugin browser; custom themes or CSS snippets that force fonts can interfere, and syncing settings requires including the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian only offers vault-wide font settings, so all notes share one typeface and size.
summary: Per-note font and font size settings applied from the right-click menu, without changing the note's Markdown content.
